purpose: Check whether every concept in the 121-concept Grade 1-6 taxonomy can resolve at least one misconception or reasoning-risk record and at least one diagnostic question after all diagnostic overlays are applied.
resolution_inputs: all extension catalogs and link overlays listed in the diagnostic extension manifest

direct_route_improvement.focus: Explain regrouping as exchange of equal place-value units rather than as a digit-level borrowing rule.

meaning_of_complete: Each concept can resolve at least one usable probe after overlays are applied. This does not mean every concept has multiple independent diagnostics or that every misconception record has high-strength empirical evidence.
quality_limits: Many domain-specific misconception records are marked curriculum_inferred and should be treated as plausible reasoning patterns to probe, not established prevalence claims.
A wrong answer never establishes a misconception by itself; diagnostic_interpretation_rules.json still requires explanation, representation or a second item.
Some concepts share a diagnostic because the same underlying mathematical structure is being tested.
Further expansion should prioritise concepts where only one probe exists or where bilingual wording needs classroom testing, rather than creating duplicate questions simply to increase count.
Diagnostic route coverage is instructional coverage, not psychometric validation.
